parameters.description:
The endpoint the puzzle is for, from the query string (?endpoint=login): signup, login,
verify, resend, forgot, reset, admin_login, admin_forgot or admin_reset. When empty, the
body's endpoint is used, and then signup.
parameters.name: endpoint

default.description: The request failed; the HTTP status says how.

post.summary:
CreateChallenge returns a proof-of-work puzzle for an endpoint. Endpoints answer 428 when
the caller must solve one: find a nonce such that sha256(challenge + ":" + nonce) in hex
starts with difficulty zeros, then retry with X-PoW-Id (challenge_id) and X-PoW-Nonce.
A puzzle works once, for the same user agent, until it expires.

post.summary:
PlaceBet prices the selections, checks the brand's limits and the player's balance, and
places the bet. Send an Idempotency-Key header (8 to 128 printable ASCII characters,
required): a retry with the same key returns the first placement (duplicate is true)
instead of placing a second bet.
